evidence: One unrequired demand found. The hard constraints gate criterion cw_shared_saved_record requires: 'Observe a successful application write response containing its exact title, filename and source' (frozen task/tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:32). The public contract requires exact title/filename/source to be saved and read by a fresh page, including after a restart (environment/instructions/behaviour.md:9), while policy.md:3 explicitly leaves routes and database schema to the builder and policy.md:5 makes public behavior the contract. Neither public text nor a professional default requires the Save HTTP response body to echo all three fields. The criterion's later independent-context server readback properly tests the requested outcome, so the response-shape clause adds no required product behavior. The constraints suite uses all_pass (judge.toml:14-15), making this a full gate false-fail. Other inspected criteria map to stated editor, preview, persistence, security, control or visual behavior; no further unrequired demand was established from the text review. No full judge run was performed for this row.
counterexample: A correct app saves the exact title, filename and source durably, returns HTTP 204 No Content (or a response containing only the new record ID), and lets a clean browser context fetch the full record and reload it after a server restart. It meets behaviour.md:9 and the gate's independent readback, but fails the gate's requirement that the write response itself contain all three fields. A weak app that echoes those fields in a write response but does not persist them would pass this clause alone, though the gate's later readback correctly rejects it.
suggested_fix: In cw_shared_saved_record, require a successful Save request or clear success in the UI plus exact fresh server readback in the independent context; remove the requirement that the write response body echo title, filename and source.
